avis.titre: Watery to dry when done on face
avis.texte: I don't see any shine/glow after using this product once soaked into my skin. Maybe this product isn't for me, I have combination skin. Its super wet and runny at first and dries up quickly and leaves my skin feeling tight. Though the tightness starts after I use their water-based cleanser....hmmm maybe the brand just isn't for me.

avis.titre: Clear and even toned skin ☺️
avis.texte: This is a great product, I’ve been using this for about a month now and I am noticing my skin has become clearer and more even toned. I also add this to my favorite body lotion…I mean why not!

avis.titre: Just like the spray
avis.texte: Good and I bought cause I couldn’t find the mist of this brand so I got this and can say it’s almost the same with hydrating and makes skin look good

avis.titre: Absolutely perfect
avis.texte: My skin loves this it absorbed so well and leaves my skin feeling not so greasy.

avis.titre: This is the first time I'm using version 3 instead of the previous version 2.
avis.texte: I'm giving it 4 stars because this is my first time trying version 3 of this serum. So far, I’ve only used this serum today, and my skin feels fine. I used to use version 2, but it was discontinued—and that was my absolute favorite serum, the one that really helped. I can’t say anything definitive about version 3 yet; I need a little more time to form a complete opinion about it.

avis.titre: 朝のお化粧前、夜のスキンケア前。何にでも合う
avis.texte: ガラクナイアシン2の頃から愛用しております。 朝のお化粧前、夜のスキンケア前に毎日使っています。 大きく効果が見えるものではないかもしれませんが、塗ると肌が整う感じがします。 その後の美容液や化粧水などが馴染みます。

avis.titre: 不思議とツヤ肌になる
avis.texte: 脂性肌特有のゴワゴワ感が落ち着いて綺麗なツヤ肌になる！ 水っぽいテクスチャーで、デパコス含めてたくさんの美容液を使ってきたけど即効効果を感じられて、本気でおすすめ

avis.titre: さっぱりした使用感。
avis.texte: 他の方も仰る通り、ホントに水みたいなテクスチャーで、化粧水の延長みたいな感じでたっぷりめに使用してみたところ、心なしかキメが整い肌のトーンも上がったように思います。使い切ってみて、より効果が期待できそうならリピありだと思いました。

avis.titre: Like a glass of water for my skin
avis.texte: What an unexpected product this is. I’ve been using Korean skincare for 15+ years and am always rotating new products in to see what new advancements there are and if the new products make my skin even better than it already is. While Korean skincare has my skin looking (almost) flawless, I do deal with dry skin, some hyperpigmentation and rosacea. This serum is just as runny as water and it hydrates dry skin just like water does. I apply several drops all over my face and the serum makes my skin feel fresh, it absorbs fast and leaves my skin feeling healthy and hydrated. While this serum is very lightweight if packs quite a punch, my skin tone looks more even, the dryness is gone and my rosacea is more calm. On top of that, the product comes in a very sturdy glass bottle and dropper which I live, I prefer skincare products to be packaged in glass to preserve the quality of the product and avoid microplastics. I was really intrigued by the ingredient of rice in this product, while many people, including celebrities, discovered the properties or rice and rice water for their hair, I should have known that it would work just as well for the skin. Rice water stimulates the scalp, hydrates it and encourages healthy hair grow and the same way it treats my sensitive skin barrier on my face, nourishes it, makes it feel more healthy and improved it’s texture. Overall this is a great, light, powerful addition to my skincare regiment and it plays well with my other products, for radian

avis.titre: K Beauty brightening serum
avis.texte: This is a Korean made brightening serum. It has kojic acid and I have used other Korean skincare containing it. Kojic acid is effective in my opinion at evening and brightening skin tone and treating discoloration. There are also all the familiar skincare heavy hitters including niacinamide, panthenol and hyalauronic acid. Value: The bottle is about twice the size of most serums containing 2 ounces not 1. I think this is a good value for a large sized serum with several active ingredients. The dropper bottle itself is substantial, attractive and protects the ingredients from light. Performance: It feels nourishing. It is not too heavy or sticky. It is inoffensive without any strong fragrance or texture. It sinks in well if you give it a few minutes to settle. It plays well with others and I have had no trouble layering, sunscreen, primer or foundation on top. Who is it for: This product does not contain hydroquinone or other skin lightening agents and that is a major plus. I believe this product will be suitable for people of all skin tones as the active ingredients will only even out your natural skin tone. This product would also be good for people with acne or discoloration from past acne which the description alludes to. I am middle aged and am using it for sunspots and general skin improvement.

avis.titre: Great addition to the Galac Niacin line
avis.texte: I'm a huge fan of Korean skincare and ma:nyo products in particular. I've used previous versions of the Galac Niacin essence serum in the past with noticeable improvement to my skin's tone and texture, so I was super excited to try the Galac Niacin 3.0 Essence! It arrived in a beautiful glass bottle containing 60ml of product, which is enough to last several months with daily application. The essence has a watery texture and feels great on the skin, with no sticky residue or oily film. I've found that my skin feels much more hydrated after application, and it preps the skin for moisturizer perfectly. It contains ingredients like Niacinamide, Kojic Acid and Glutathione to fade stubborn pigmentation and discoloration, and I'm excited to see how my hyperpigmentation/acne scars fade and improvement to my rosacea. I've only been using this essence for about a week, but so far I'm beyond satisfied with its performance. My skin feels hydrated, and with a few more weeks of use I expect to see improvement to my hyperpigmentation/acne scars. I'll update this review in a few weeks with new details on its performance!

avis.titre: Impressive Korean Serum for Brighter, Clearer Skin
avis.texte: Oh, once again, a Korean skincare product has completely impressed me. Although this serum claims visible improvements in about two weeks, I’ve only been using it for around a week and am already noticing my dark spots and blemishes fading. My overall skin tone looks brighter, and my previously dull, rough texture has improved. The key ingredients seem carefully chosen and really suit my skin, making this serum feel almost like a personalized essence for me. In the past, I’ve tried other Korean serums I liked, but some had an unpleasant smell I had to tolerate. Fortunately, this serum has no strange odor. Its thin, water-like texture absorbs easily without feeling sticky or heavy, and thankfully hasn’t caused any skin irritation. At the current price for 60ml, I think it’s a very good value for such a high-quality serum. After just a week, I can already feel the effects, and I’m excited to see how much more my skin will improve with continued use!

avis.titre: Loving it so far
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for a short time, so it's too early to judge long term results, but I like what I see so far. The formula feels very lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness. My skin hasn't had any irritation, which is always the first thing I look for with new treatments. The ingredient list is impressive. It combines galactomyces with niacinamide, kojic acid, and glutathione, all known for brightening and helping with dark spots. It also has hyaluronic acid and ceramides for hydration and barrier support. I like that this brand continues to refine their formulas, and this feels like a polished update. Manyo is a brand I've trusted for years, and it's well regarded in Korea too, not just outside of it. That gives me confidence in trying their new releases. While it will take time to see real changes in tone and clarity, the texture, comfort, and thoughtful blend of actives already make this serum a solid part of my routine.

avis.titre: Love this brand! Great, light serum that doesn’t leave your skin sticky
avis.texte: This Korean brightening serum combines kojic acid with niacinamide, panthenol, and hyaluronic acid. I’ve used other kojic acid products and find it effective for brightening, evening skin tone, and fading discoloration. The 2-ounce bottle is a great value and comes in a sturdy dropper that protects the formula from light. The serum feels lightweight and nourishing, absorbs quickly, and layers well under sunscreen, primer, or foundation. The texture and consistency is watery and light but it goes on well. It doesn’t contain harsh lightening agents like hydroquinone, making it suitable for all skin tones. I use it for sunspots and overall skin brightening, and it works beautifully! I’ve tried other products from this brand and always love the results!

avis.titre: Brightening Essence with Ferments and Niacinamide for Calm, Hydrated Skin (Ingredients Listed)
avis.texte: Ma:Nyo’s Galac Niacin 3.0 Essence is a lightweight, watery serum that blends fermented filtrates with niacinamide and hydrators to calm, brighten, and refine the skin. It’s elegant in presentation, gentle in performance, and quietly effective—especially for those seeking a non-sticky, fast-absorbing formula that layers well and soothes without drama. I received my serum in a Ma:Nyo branded white box about 1¾ inches square and 5 inches tall. It opens in a unique way, unzipping along the side and unfolding flat to reveal a thoughtful note explaining the company’s philosophy and inspiration. Inside sits a frosted glass bottle containing clear liquid, capped with a gold and white glass dropper. The presentation is pure K-beauty with the added elegance of a glass bottle and dropper—clean, minimal, and giftable. Ingredients are listed on the box. The formula begins with galactomyces ferment filtrate, a probiotic-rich yeast extract known for brightening, refining texture, and supporting the skin barrier. Niacinamide follows as a proven multitasker—balancing oil, fading discoloration, and improving elasticity. Humectants like butylene glycol, glycerin, pentylene glycol, and panthenol hydrate and soothe, while 1,2-hexanediol and ethylhexylglycerin offer mild preservation. Sodium hyaluronate and hyaluronic acid provide multi-layer hydration, while beta-glucan and bisabolol calm irritation. Acetyl glucosamine and kojic acid support brightening and exfoliation, and tocopherol (vitamin E)

avis.titre: Hydrates, brightens, and balances
avis.texte: This essence has a very lightweight, watery texture that absorbs almost instantly, leaving my skin feeling refreshed, hydrated, and not sticky at all. It layers beautifully under serums, moisturizers, and even makeup without any pilling. I like this product is the combination of Galactomyces ferment and Niacinamide. My skin feels a bit brighter and radiant. Areas that used to look tired and patchy now feel smoother, and my overall complexion feels healthier. It’s also gentle for sensitive skin. I haven’t experienced any irritation, redness, or breakouts, which is a plus. I use it both in the morning and at night, and I feel like it’s helping to strengthen my skin barrier while keeping it hydrated throughout the day.

avis.titre: Decent Korean serum and not too expensive
avis.texte: This review is for "MA:NYO Galac Niacin 3.0 Essence Korean Facial Serum, Ultra Hydrating, Tone Balancing, Niacinamide, for Women and Men Korean Skin care" which was offered for ~$22 at the time I ordered it. At this price range for 2 oz, it's a little expensive but not in comparison to some other imported or premium brands. I found that this serum was hydrating and did not irritate my sensitive/combination skin, but I also did not find much improvement in any of my blemishes or dark spots after two weeks of use. With that said, I do like how light this is and the dropper makes it easy to apply and not waste product, so I will continue to use this in my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Very thin serum is a bit difficult to use but may be worth it
avis.texte: The directions call for applying a few drops evenly across the face and tapping lightly until the serum is fully absorbed. This is difficult to do because it is very runny. It will absorb once given enough time in the same place, but its first instinct is to run, run, run down and away. After application, my face feels dry for a while, then just a bit dry but mostly smooth. If I didn't believe in the ingredients, I would have no motivation to keep using this because it is kind of annoying to apply. I haven't noticed any effects after a couple of weeks, but I'm hopeful.

avis.titre: Balanced Radiance, No Scent, Korean Niacin Facial Serum
avis.texte: I really like this Korean facial serum. It contains niacin and provides excellent tone balancing while deeply hydrating the skin. The bottle is clear and sleek, and the formula absorbs quickly without leaving residue. It has no scent, which I really appreciate, and it’s gentle on my skin. I’ve noticed it helps fade dark spots and blemishes, leaving my complexion brighter. I also love the thoughtful packaging, when you open the box, it greets you with a “hello” message and shares the company’s mission to give back to the community and environment. Beautifully done inside and out.

avis.titre: Very good facial essence with 93% galactomyces (yeast) filtrate and niacinamide
avis.texte: This review is about the product “ma:nyo Galac Niacin 3.0 Essence Korean Facial Serum, Ultra Hydrating, Tone Balancing, Niancinamide, for Women and Men Korean Skin care 2.02 fl oz (60ml)”. There are a lot of hot discussion about differences between toner/essence/serum when they might have quite a similar body texture and might feature the same active ingredients in the formulation. This product from the Korean brand ma:nyo has “essence” name on the bottle and both “essence” and “serum” in the product title. I would not call it a “serum”, it is an essence or a concentrated toner -- I saw similar ingredients in toner formulations and I do not see here potent concentration of actives that would qualify it as a serum (even niacinamide should be at least above 5%). If I understand correctly 3.0 in the product name “Galac Niacin 3.0 Essence” means version/generation #3 in this product formulation. For example, the version 2.0 differs from the original version mainly by the change in percentage in galactomyces filtrate (97% -> 93.69%) and niacinamide (2% -> 4%), the rest ingredients remain mainly the same. The ingredient list of the v.3.0 product does not explicitly stated this percentage anymore, but the product description says that it is still formulated with 93.7% of galactomyces filtrate. However, niacinamide is shifted down (from #2 to #3) by butylene glycol, panthenol is shifted down too (from #3 to #8). However, v.3.0 seems to have a more complex formula over v.2.0, by addin

avis.titre: Unscented and absorbs quickly
avis.texte: This review is for ma:nyo Galac Niacin 3.0 Essence Korean Facial Serum, which is made in Korea. This is a clear, unscented liquid that is very watery. It sinks into the skin and absorbs quickly and dries without being sticky or shiny. It is as essence so it is meant to have other products applied after it. The essence worked well with my moisturizers and did not cause pilling or streaking. It will take a while to see the effects of the active ingredients but for now this provided a good base for my other products. Face felt a little tight if I used this only and nothing else on top so it lost a star for that. At a price of $21.99 for 2.02 oz I think this is a great value for the money. I did not experience any irritation when using the product and you can see the ingredient list in the final image.

avis.titre: Great combo of ingredients
avis.texte: This is my first time using a product with galactomyces and kojic acid, and I’m super happy that my skin is happy with it. I have combination skin which isn’t very sensitive, so this essence works very well in my current skincare routine and absorbs quickly. The consistency is much thinner than I anticipated and I don’t want to lose product on a cotton round, so I found it helpful to apply small amounts directly to my face using the dropper then tapping it in. I don’t have hyperpigmentation, but I’m anxious to see the brightening effects with continued use.

avis.titre: A really lovely serum
avis.texte: So this is an updated version of an existing serum, hence the name 3.0 Essence. I’ve tried the 2.0 essence in the past with great success, The ingredients in this is really cool. Besides fermented materials, there is niacinamide, kojic acid and glutathione. In my search for brightening ingredients to keep my melisma in check, I’ve found that Kojic acid is actually hard to come by, so I’m very excited by this formula. It’s fragrance free and the texture is lovely - watery but not too runny. On a hot day, it’s enough to moisturize my skin alone. I highly recommend it.

avis.titre: Niacin serum- good for oily skin.
avis.texte: This niacin serum offers an effective treatment for hydration and balancing. I’ve been using mostly hyaluronic acid based serums on a daily basis. My skin care routine has evolved and developed over time, and it does appear that a niacinamide product should be introduced. My skin has oily areas near my nose and on my chin. My skin is not particularly dry unless the weather conditions are harsh. So, it appears that a niacin product might be a better choice for the oily areas. I’m excited to introduce it, drop by drop, into my daily applications.

avis.titre: Good quality, lightweight and watery hydrating essence
avis.texte: This has been nice for me so far. It is a very lightweight, watery serum or essence. It comes in a glass bottle with an unusual shaped dropper that does a good job of holding and transferring the liquid to your hand. You'll want to apply it quickly when holding the serum because it absorbs fast and has a very runny texture. It is clear and does not leave any residue. I also did not notice any scent. It feels like it is moisturizing on my combo skin. The price is pretty good, as this feels like a quality product.

avis.titre: Love it !
avis.texte: I really like this essence ! It’s a pretty strong brightening treatment . I love the consistency, it’s just a little thicker than water but it hydrates the skin immediately . I am especially happy to have this for all the hyperpigmentation and dullness I’m experiencing after a long summer . It works well with other skincare on top and it works under makeup . It absorbs quickly and not leaves behind softness . It has no scent at all . It has a Beautiful frosted glass bottle with dropper .

avis.titre: Hydrating Niacinamide Serum
avis.texte: I am always a fan of ma:nyo products, so I was excited to try this niacinamide serum. I have a few minor pigmentation spots and am always looking for ways to fade them. I have been using it for about a week now, so it’s too soon to judge its full effectiveness. That said, my skin has shown no irritation, which is great. The serum has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. It provides a nice boost of hydration and layers well with my moisturizer. Overall, I am happy with how it feels so far and will continue using it to see longer-term results.
